name: LevelNetwork Voxis Accessibility & Audio Summarizer
author: sonofgod80

sections.description:
LevelNetwork Voxis Accessibility & Audio Summarizer improves your website’s accessibility by offering users an intuitive, lightweight audio player to listen to your articles.

The free version securely utilizes the visitor’s native Web Speech API built directly into modern browsers, completely eliminating external API costs and server overhead.

Features

  • Native TTS Engine: Leverages the browser’s Web Speech API (100% Free, zero server load).
  • WCAG Compliant Player: An accessible mini-player automatically injected at the top of posts.
  • Flexible Display Options: Choose to display the player above or below content, on posts, pages, both, or disable auto-display to use the [voxis_summarizer_player] shortcode.
  • Exclude by ID: Easily disable the player on specific posts or pages by entering their IDs.
  • Customizable Speeds & Volume: Provide users the ability to read at preferred speeds (1.0x, 1.25x, 1.5x) and adjust the volume dynamically via the built-in volume slider.
  • Content Filtering: Safely exclude unrelated blocks (like read-times or share links) using CSS Selectors directly from Settings.
  • Secure & Lightweight: Written with strict adherence to WordPress coding standards, fully sanitised, and uses no inline scripts or styles.

Premium Features (PRO)

Looking for maximum quality and advanced features? Upgrade to Voxis PRO to unlock cloud neural voices, AI summaries, and background bulk generation.

Upgrade to PRO for an advanced suite of tools and professional features:

  • AI Audio Summaries: Generate intelligent ‘TL;DR’ text and dedicated audio summaries using AI engines like GPT-4o Mini, Claude 3, or Google Gemini.
  • Hyper-Realistic Neural Voices: Use top-tier cloud TTS models (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google Cloud) for perfect narration identical on all devices.
  • Bulk Generator: Process thousands of posts or pages in the background to automatically generate audio and summaries, keeping your site fully accessible in one click.
  • Text Highlighting Sync: Keep users engaged with a visual word-by-word highlight tracing the text as it is read (available for full article reading).
  • Draggable Floating Player: The player smoothly sticks to the corner of the screen so your visitors can continue listening while scrolling through long articles.
  • Audio Jump Controls: Let users skip forward or backward incrementally (e.g. +/- 10s) while listening to Neural Voices or AI Summaries.
  • Download MP3: Allow your users to download the high-quality Neural Voice MP3 to listen offline.
  • Custom Post Metabox & Row Actions: A dedicated post control box and row actions to manually regenerate or delete the audio or summary when updating an old post.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the levelnetwork-voxis-audio-summarizer folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings -> Voxis Audio to enable and configure the web speech rules.
sections.faq:
Does it send my data to third parties?

No. The free version runs exclusively locally in the visitor’s browser using the standardized Web Speech API. There is no silent tracking.

What is the Web Speech API?

The Web Speech API is a browser-native feature that provides text-to-speech capabilities directly from the user’s device.

Why is the voice different on iPhone and Windows?

Since the free plugin uses the user’s device to synthesize speech natively, the voice heard depends entirely on the operating system and browser they are using. If you want identical, studio-quality voices on all devices, consider upgrading to PRO.

Can I place the player anywhere?

Yes! You can disable the automatic display on Posts or Pages and use the [voxis_summarizer_player] shortcode to manually position the audio player inside any Page Builder (Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, etc.).

Does the player support volume control?

Yes! In the latest updates, we integrated a responsive volume slider. Users can perfectly adjust the audio level within the player context. Note that for native Web Speech TTS, volume adjustments take effect at the start of the next spoken sentence.
sections.changelog:
1.0.6

  • New: Added “Prepend Title to Audio” setting to optionally exclude the post or page title from TTS readout if it is already captured by your content CSS selector.
  • New: The volume selected by the user is now saved via localStorage and automatically applied across all pages and future visits.
  • Fix: Addressed minor synchronization issues with CSS parsing.

1.0.5

  • Fix: Addressed an issue causing server errors or crashing with specific page builders (e.g. Avada/Enfold) by refining how shortcodes are processed during content extraction.
  • Fix: The article’s Title is now properly extracted and included at the beginning of the text to be read by the TTS or AI engine.
  • Tweak: Under-the-hood hooks preparation for advanced CSS selector instructions in the PRO version.

1.0.4

  • New: Added Share Audio Snippet functionality. Allows sharing a direct link to a specific timestamp in the audio.
  • Fix: Timeline and player buttons alignment adjustments.

1.0.3

  • New: Added a Volume Bar Notification tooltip explaining that native volume changes take effect on the next sentence.
  • Fix: Bug fixes, logic updates, and styling improvements.

1.0.2

  • New: Option to place the player above or below content.
  • New: Option to completely hide the automatic player (“None” in “Enable On”) and use the [voxis_summarizer_player] shortcode for manual placement.
  • New: Exclude specific posts/pages by ID.
  • Fix: Improved sanitization and security updates.
  • Fix: Added compatibility checks and warnings for API key validation.

1.0.1

  • PRO Version features integration and UI fixes.
  • Added support for Draggable Floating Player, Text Highlighting, and MP3 Downloads (requires PRO).

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
